name: 色盲模拟器 Pro
ed: Color Blindness Simulator Pro - Simulate 8 types of color vision deficiency in real time: protanopia, protanomaly, deuteranopia, deuteranomaly, tritanopia, tritanomaly, achromatopsia and blue-cone monochromacy. Transform a single color, a whole palette or an uploaded image; built-in WCAG 2.1 contrast checker, CIE Lab delta-E confusion matrix and color-blind-safe palette generator. Free, browser-only, images never leave your device.
